facts.statement: Fosterovenator is a genus of ceratosaur dinosaur found in the Late Jurassic Morrison Formation of Wyoming.
facts.quote: Fosterovenator (meaning "Foster's hunter") is a genus of ceratosaur dinosaur known from the Late Jurassic Morrison Formation of Wyoming.

facts.statement: A paratype specimen of Fosterovenator is a complete right fibula belonging to a larger individual.
facts.quote: An additional specimen is known, the paratype YPM VP 058267D, a fibula of a larger individual.

facts.statement: The paratype fibula of Fosterovenator measures 27.5 cm in length.
facts.quote: The paratype consists of a complete right fibula measuring 27.5 cm in length and belonging to a much larger individual.

facts.statement: It is debated whether the paratype of Fosterovenator truly belongs to the ceratosaurian group.
facts.quote: However, ceratosaurian affinities of Fosterovenator (at least of the paratype) have been questioned.

facts.statement: Fosterovenator fossils were discovered in 1879 by Othniel Charles Marsh and Arthur Lakes at Quarry 12 in Como Bluff, Wyoming.
facts.quote: In 1879 during an expedition by paleontologists Othniel Charles Marsh and Arthur Lakes to the Quarry 12 outcrop of the Brushy Basin Member of the Morrison Formation in Como Bluff, Wyoming, several small theropod fossils were unearthed.

facts.statement: The genus Fosterovenator was formally described in 2014 by Sebastian G. Dalman in the journal Volumina Jurassica.
facts.quote: YPM VP 058267 A-D was described in scientific literature in the journal Volumina Jurassica in 2014 by researcher Sebastian G. Dalman.

facts.statement: The genus name Fosterovenator honors paleontologist John R. Foster and the Greek word for hunter.
facts.quote: The generic name Fosterovenator honors paleontologist John R. Foster and the Greek root venator ("hunter").

facts.statement: The species name churei honors paleontologist Daniel J. Chure.
facts.quote: The specific name churei honors paleontologist Daniel J. Chure.

facts.statement: Fosterovenator lived during the Late Jurassic, approximately 155 to 147 million years ago.
facts.quote: The strata of Quarry 12 derive from the late Kimmeridgian to early Tithonian stages of the Late Jurassic, in numerical terms around 155 to 147 million years old.

facts.statement: Fosterovenator is classified within the superfamily Ceratosauria.
Fosterovenator belongs to the family Ceratosauridae.
The authority for the genus Fosterovenator is Dalman, 2014.
The authority for the species Fosterovenator churei is Dalman, 2014.
The fossil record of Fosterovenator spans from the Kimmeridgian to the Tithonian stages (154.8 to 143.1 million years ago).
facts.quote: Time range: Kimmeridgian to Tithonian (154.8 to 143.1 million years ago)

rejected.quote: The holotype is YPM VP 058267A, B, and C, a tibia with an articulated astragalus.

rejected.quote: The paleoenvironment of the Morrison Formation is interpreted as a semiarid environment with distinct wet and dry seasons, and flat floodplains.
